dangerous.line: Mama, do you think she's dangerous
stanza: Mother, do you think she's good enough
Mama, do you think she's dangerous
Mama, will she tear your little boy apart?
Ooh, Mother, will she break my heart?

dangerous.line: What made it special made it dangerous
stanza: You're like my yo-yo that glowed in the dark
What made it special made it dangerous
So I bury it and forget
